services.desc: From non-profit fundraisers, bar/bat mitzvahs, birthday celebrations, retirement parties, or just an excuse to get together - The Blackhawk Museum offers a unique space to take your special event to the next level. Create moments that your guests will be talking about for years to come. Please complete the below inquiry form and Gina Longmire from West Coast Events Group will be in touch with you shortly. services.desc: Please complete this request form for your Adult/Senior/Youth Group Tour and submit it four (4) weeks prior to your preferred tour date. Self-Guided tours with 10 people or more are required to submit a Group Tour Request Form. Group admission pricing is extended if tickets are paid in advance or with one group ticket purchase at the Reception Desk at the time of the tour.
